prompt: Query the 'Opened Email' metric and return a daily series of values for the last 7 days. Put the answer inside `final_answer` as a JSON array of exactly 7 objects, each with fields: date, value. Order by date ascending (oldest first).

claims.description: each bucket has date and value

claims.expected: The 7 date strings are ordered chronologically ascending (oldest first), with no duplicates and one entry per calendar day.
claims.description: dates are in correct chronological order

notes: Uses query_metric_aggregates. Date ordering goes to the judge because the structural grader can only sort by numeric keys.
